name: Joby CRM
description:
Connect Claude to Joby CRM to quickly find and understand your business data through natural conversation.

Claude can securely access your Joby CRM leads, clients, appointments, schedules, estimates, invoices, payments, job types, service areas, team members, lead statuses, custom fields, and activity timelines.

Use the connector to find customers, review lead history, understand upcoming appointments, analyze your pipeline, review estimates and invoices, summarize CRM activity, and answer questions about your Joby data without switching between screens.

The Joby CRM connector is read-only. Claude cannot create, edit, send, delete, charge, refund, or otherwise modify data through this connector. Each connection is authorized to a specific Joby organization by an owner or administrator.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Joby CRM to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Joby CRM to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.joby.io/v1/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Joby CRM MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Joby CRM lists 31 MCP tools, including get_agent, get_appointment, get_client, get_estimate, get_estimate_template, get_invoice, get_job_type, get_lead, get_lead_status, get_lead_timeline, get_payment, and get_service_area.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Joby CRM?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Joby CRM in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.

_published_faq.name: Does Joby CRM MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Joby CRM requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Joby CRM is developed by Joby. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
